components.name: vieww-gestures
components.description: The vieww gesture layer: the arena, the recognisers, and scroll physics.

components.name: vieww-gpu
components.description: The GPU execution layer: a brutally small backend-agnostic HAL (Device/Queue/Buffer/Texture/Pipeline/Encoder/Fence/Surface), a resource virtualization layer, and CPU-side geometry prep (tessellation, batching, instancing) shared by every backend.

components.name: vieww-hal
components.description: vieww's hardware abstraction layer: a sealed Vulkan/Metal/D3D12 device trait, independent of the paint model — the foundation the vello replacement's GPU path builds on.

components.name: vieww-image
components.description: Image capabilities past decode-and-display: mipmap chains, texture atlas packing, animated-image frame sequencing, colour-profile awareness, and a residency-budgeted decoded-image cache — the pieces GPU upload and long-running apps need that a decode-on-demand asset cache does not provide on its own.

components.name: vieww-mesh
components.description: The vieww mesh layer: OBJ and STL geometry, parsed into triangles.

components.name: vieww-network
components.description: The vieww network layer: requests, responses, and the client seam.

components.name: vieww-paint
components.description: The vieww paint layer: canvas, scenes, layers, damage tracking, and vieww's own ground-up rasterizer.

components.name: vieww-physics
components.description: The vieww physics layer: 2D bodies, collisions, and an impulse solver.

components.name: vieww-platform-winit
components.description: The vieww platform bridge: a window, a swapchain, a lifecycle and raw input, via winit.

components.name: vieww-render
components.description: The vieww render tree: the constraints-down/sizes-up layout protocol, hit testing and paint.

components.name: vieww-render-graph
components.description: A first-class render graph: passes, resources, dependency analysis, transient aliasing, culling, batching, compiled into a backend-agnostic execution plan.

components.name: vieww-render-planner
components.description: Cost-aware CPU/GPU/hybrid execution planning: turns a render graph's ExecutionPlan into a per-pass placement decision for a specific device.

components.name: vieww-say-codegen
components.description: Say: the English-facing screen language for vieww. Parses .say and generates the Rust the studio compiles.

components.name: vieww-scene
components.description: Renderer-independent scene IR: the boundary between the paint layer and the render graph/planner/GPU stack.

components.name: vieww-shaders
components.description: vieww's shader system: one WGSL library, cross-compiled through naga to SPIR-V/MSL/HLSL, with reflection, pipeline cache keys, and hot-reload hooks — the shared foundation every GPU backend (vieww-hal's vulkan/metal/d3d12 modules) compiles its shaders through, so there is exactly one place shader source lives.

components.name: vieww-spatial
components.description: Native 3D scene, CPU rasterizer, physics, particles and spatial animation for ViewW.

components.name: vieww-text
components.description: The vieww text layer: font loading, shaping, line breaking and bidirectional paragraph layout.

components.name: vieww-video
components.description: The vieww video layer: sources, players, and the frame clock.

components.name: vieww-widget
components.description: The vieww widget tree: cheap, immutable descriptions of UI.

components.name: vieww-widget-macros
components.description: The #[widget] attribute: writes the Widget impl's mechanical half — debug_name, kind, and the WidgetNode conversion — so a composed widget is a struct and a build method, the way it reads in the head.
